fields.statement: Verifier at 13770358 (attempt 2): `go test -trimpath -count=1 -run 'TestDaemonNudge|Stall' -v ./internal/api/` passes TestDaemonNudgeStalled. Read the test and diff: on a fake clock with a session.Store and a fake sender, an autonomous run A whose session 'auto' now reports hook state idle (Autonomous record, so session.Stalled stalls it after StallAfter=20m) and an owner-attended run O whose session reports working go through daemonNudgeStalled: no send at 19m; exactly one message to 'auto' at 21m, checked to contain 'background shell' and '`rhiza session done`'; a poll at 25m on the same stall sends nothing; runStalledAll still lists both stalled sessions (2) after the nudge; a new report then 21 silent minutes sends a second message; 'owner' is never sent to; a failed send is retried next poll. daemonNudgeStalled skips states whose own run.State.Autonomous is false and keys each stall on session@since; daemonNudge feeds it live, non-ended runs and is called from runDaemon's poll (daemon.go:195). This fixes compliance f1 (idle stall now driven through the nudge).
